description: Verify that DUT replies to a tester-injected data segment with a pure ACK whose ack_num covers the payload (RFC 793 p74)
approach:
[Objective]
The baseline ACK-for-data check: after handshake, DUT receives a data segment in ESTABLISHED and must emit a pure ACK with ack_num covering the received bytes. RFC 793 p74 mandates this.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: 3-way handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data segment (ACK + payload).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: pure ACK
   • ack_num == seg.seq + payload_len   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted ACK ack_num equals the post-payload sequence number.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_data_ack — no DUT ACK to data
• Fail_wrong_ack_num — ACK value does not cover the payload

verdicts.Pass: DUT acknowledged the data with correct ack_num — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_ack_num: DUT ack_num does not acknowledge payload
